title: sorghum humile
intro: Sorghum humile, commonly known as broom sorghum or broom grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in various parts of the world, including Africa, Asia, and Australia, due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sorghum humile include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, as well as its use in traditional medicine to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sorghum humile include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
